brief:
An Israeli mob attacked Palestinian citizens during a far-right march in Lod, Middle East Eye reported, leaving several residents injured. The clash erupted as right-wing Israeli activists demonstrated in the city, which has a significant Palestinian population.

Palestinian residents expressed fear of further attacks following the incident. The rally sparked wider clashes in the area, with tensions between Israeli and Palestinian communities intensifying.
